title: Modernisation and westernisation

draft.title: Modernisation and westernisation
card: the shift from a traditional way of life, often based on farming and village ties, to an industrial and urban one. It usually involves factories, growing cities and new technology.
a society taking on the ideas, habits or institutions of Western countries, such as their fashion, food, language or style of government.
The two can happen together, but they are not the same. A society can modernise without copying the West, and it can adopt Western habits without industrialising.
To tell them apart, ask what is changing. A move from farm work to factory work and city life is modernisation. Taking up Western clothing or food is westernisation.
draft.remember: Modernisation is about how a society lives and works. Westernisation is about whose ways it copies.

a.q: Which change is an example of modernisation rather than westernisation?
opts: Villagers move to a city to work in new factories
Teenagers in a town start wearing Western brands
A country adopts English as its main school language
A family replaces its local meals with Western fast food
a.why: Moving from village life to factory work and city living is a shift from traditional to industrial and urban life. The other options are about taking on Western styles, language or food, which is westernisation, even though fast food and brands can feel modern.
a.clue: Which change is about industry and cities, not about copying the West?

b.q: Over thirty years, a nation builds many factories and its farming villages shrink as people move to cities. Its people keep their own language, dress and food. Which statement fits this case?
opts: It has modernised but has not westernised
It has westernised but has not modernised
It has both modernised and westernised
It has neither modernised nor westernised
b.why: Factories, urban growth and the move away from farming show modernisation. The people keep their own language, dress and food, so there is no sign of taking on Western ways. Modernisation can happen without westernisation.
b.clue: Check separately for industrial and urban change, and for Western habits.

a.best: Villagers move to a city to work in new factories

b.best: It has modernised but has not westernised
